MCD commences pilot drone survey to improve property tax assessment in Delhi

2026-09-23 Express News Service (New Indian Express) MCD, Delhi, drone survey, property tax, GIS, LiDAR, geo-tagging, 3D modelling, aerial mapping, municipal mapping
Read the source article

Quick summary

The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has launched a pilot drone-based survey combining GIS, LiDAR mapping, geo-tagging, AI, and 3D digital modelling to build a more accurate property database and identify under-assessed properties for tax collection.

Key takeaways

  • The MCD launched a pilot drone survey in two wards (Rohini F Ward and Gharoli Ward) to improve property tax assessment
  • The survey combines drone imagery with GIS, LiDAR-based mapping, geo-tagging, artificial intelligence, and 3D digital modelling
  • The technology will identify incorrectly mapped or duplicate property records and detect additional floors or constructions not in existing records
  • The system enables comparison of declared versus actual built-up areas for tax assessment
  • Ward- and zone-level dashboards will help monitor discrepancies, issue notices, and track arrears
  • The exercise aims to reduce reliance on manual inspections and improve transparency for residents
